description: peter("Find trials for this indication", indication) in a trusted project whose .gptr/mcp.json configures a ClinicalTrials-style MCP server with 12 tools: the tools reach the model as R signatures in the T1 <mcp> catalog (no tool declarations), and one composed r call runs peter$mcp$trials$search_trials() and filters the data frame it returns. The object expression of `indication` seeds the tool cache from .bench/trials-tools.json and trusts the temporary project, so no server is contacted.
environment:
Date: 2026-09-29
Working directory: /Users/me/project (project root)
Front end: interactive console (RStudio)
R 4.4.3 on aarch64-apple-darwin20; RAM 24 GB (17 GB free)

objects.indication:
local({
  key = cli::hash_sha256('{"url":"https://trials.example/mcp"}')
  dir = file.path(tools::R_user_dir('gptr', 'cache'), 'mcp-tools')
  dir.create(dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  file.copy('.bench/trials-tools.json', file.path(dir, paste0(key, '.json')), overwrite = TRUE)
  gptr::gptr_trust('.', trust = TRUE)
  'idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis'
})

input.code:
trials = peter$mcp$trials$search_trials(condition = indication, status = "RECRUITING",
                                       phase = "PHASE2|PHASE3", limit = 50)
dim(trials)
head(trials[order(trials$start_date, decreasing = TRUE), c("nct_id", "phase", "enrollment", "sponsor")], 6)
